label: Ohme Home Pro smart EV charger
description: Ohme Home Pro is a 7 kW / 11 kW tethered smart charger with a colour LCD, three control buttons and tariff-aware scheduling through the Ohme app. Connectivity ships in two variants: a Wi-Fi/Bluetooth model with 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n plus Bluetooth, or a 4G model with a pre-fitted multi-network SIM; neither variant has an Ethernet port or PoE.
